allow: Bash(ls -d */ 2>/dev/null | head -100; echo "---with pom---"; find . -maxdepth 2 -name pom.xml -not -path './legacy/*' | sed 's|^\\./||;s|/pom.xml||' | sort)

Bash(cd /d/hantsylabs/spring-reactive-sample
mkdir -p ../deprecation-survey
echo "Starting survey at $\(date\)"
for d in */; do
  m="${d%/}"
  [ -f "$m/pom.xml" ] || continue
  echo "Compiling $m..."
  \( cd "$m" && ./mvnw -B clean test-compile \\
    -Dmaven.compiler.showDeprecation=true \\
    -Dmaven.compiler.showWarnings=true \\
    > "../../deprecation-survey/$m.log" 2>&1 \)
  echo "$m: exit $?"
done
echo "Survey complete at $\(date\)")
